lenses.name: Architecture future de l'économie agentique Bitcoin (3-5 ans)
lenses.question: Project the architecture of a mature autonomous-agent economy on Bitcoin in the 3-5 year horizon (2028-2030). Identify EVERY structural layer that will need to exist : settlement, identity, reputation, capability discovery, content addressing, dispute resolution, capital allocation, capacity matching, audit, governance, programmability. For each layer, name the dominant primitive/protocol that will likely fill it (e.g. 'NIP-XX for identity', 'Cashu for blinded receipts', 'Taproot Assets for Lightning-native stablecoins'). Then place SatRank precisely in this picture : which layers does it occupy today, which adjacent layers should it occupy by 2028, and which layers will become commodity infrastructure that SatRank should NOT try to own. Be specific about technical primitives — this is not a marketing exercise.

lenses.name: Profondeur de l'innovation SatRank vs reproductibilité
lenses.question: List SatRank's specific innovations as shipped today : (a) structured `attempts[]` schema with preimage + body_sha256 + per-attempt operator_pubkey + reason taxonomy ; (b) Phase 7 operator bonds + ClaimEngine with 1×/2×/3×/5× multipliers ; (c) Phase 8 Ed25519 evidence bundles + DNS TXT operator attestation ; (d) Phase 11A.2 structured error envelope with next_action enum ; (e) Phase 11B agent_bonds + reputation_score + tier-gating ; (f) Phase 12 BM25 + IntentRanker + capability inference + 5xx/validator/replay quarantine. For EACH innovation, evaluate : (1) is this PROFOUND (creates a moat that can't be cloned in <6 months by a well-funded competitor) or DECORATIVE (a competitor with similar resources reproduces it in weeks) ? (2) does it solve a STRUCTURAL problem of agent economies or a MOMENTARY symptom ? (3) which 1-2 of these innovations could be combined into something genuinely defensible ? Be harsh : the founder paid for adversarial analysis.

lenses.name: Concurrents + alternatives + bayesian probabilities
lenses.question: Map the competitive landscape SatRank faces in the agentic economy. Cover at minimum : (a) x402 (USDC on EVM) — has 100× SatRank's volume today, well-funded by Coinbase, ergonomically simpler ; (b) Lightning Labs Taproot Assets — enables USDC-style stablecoins ON Lightning, would obsolete SatRank's L402-only thesis if it lands ; (c) MCP (Anthropic standard) — agents coordinate via MCP, where does payment fit ? (d) future stablecoin-native L402 (USDT-on-Lightning, RGB) ; (e) proprietary Anthropic/OpenAI agent payment infrastructure (could be released any quarter) ; (f) Cashu/fedimint for ecash settlement ; (g) Nostr-native marketplaces (Yakihonne, etc.). For each competitor, give a Bayesian probability they capture > 50% of agentic-economy payments by 2028, AND state what would have to be true for SatRank to remain relevant in their world. Identify the SINGLE biggest existential threat and the strategic move SatRank must make in the next 6 months to survive it.

lenses.name: Innovations manquantes que SatRank devrait inventer (pas reproduire)
lenses.question: Brainstorm 8-12 innovations SatRank could invent that DON'T EXIST anywhere today and that would make SatRank structurally indispensable to the agentic economy. Constraints : (1) each must be Lightning-native or compatible (no x402 / EVM) ; (2) each must be defensible — meaning it would take a competitor 6+ months to reproduce, ideally because of network effects or accumulated data ; (3) each must serve agents specifically, not generic L402 consumers. Ideas to seed your thinking, but go beyond them : (a) capacity bonding (operators stake CAPACITY not just sats) ; (b) federated agent reputation graphs across SatRank instances ; (c) dispute resolution markets where validators stake bond ; (d) programmable agent contracts via Lightning HTLCs + RGB ; (e) intent-derivative markets (futures/options on intent prices) ; (f) reputation-collateralised credit lines ; (g) cross-jurisdictional compliance attestation chains ; (h) capability-schema standardisation moves (propose a SatRank L402 v2 that includes input/output JSON Schema natively). Rank these by (defensibility × leverage × shipability). Pick the top 3 — these are SatRank's real innovation roadmap.

lenses.name: Risques existentiels + modes d'échec
lenses.question: Identify the 7 most likely ways SatRank fails to become essential to the agentic economy, in order of probability. For each : (1) describe the failure scenario concretely with names of triggering events ; (2) estimate the timeline (in months) before the trigger materialises ; (3) identify what SatRank would need to do TODAY to inoculate against it. Cover at minimum : (a) catalog adoption flatline — Phase 10 self-registration stays at 0 forever, the only operators are the 5 incumbents ; (b) incumbent capture — bitcoinbenji, llm402.ai, lightningenable form a closed cartel that signals 'we are SatRank' to agents ; (c) Anthropic / OpenAI ship competing agent-payment protocol bundled with their SDK ; (d) USDC-on-Lightning lands and most agents move to dollar-denominated payments ; (e) regulatory capture — KYC/AML rules force SatRank to know-your-agent, breaking the pseudonymity primitive ; (f) Lightning routing fails to scale to agentic-economy throughput (1M+ qps M2M) ; (g) the niche where SatRank is currently indispensable (regulatory retention) shrinks because agents adopt direct on-chain attestation primitives. Then identify the SINGLE failure mode the founder is most blind to.

lenses.name: Path forward — où parier les 12 prochains mois
lenses.question: Given the founder constraints (single dev / Claude Code, $X capital, 12 months runway, Lightning-pure identity), produce a strict-priority 12-month execution plan. Consider TWO macro-strategies and recommend the better one with reasoning : (A) Deepen the niche : double down on compliance/audit/regulator-grade record-keeping as SatRank's positioning. Phase 10 outreach targets fintech & crypto compliance officers, not agent builders. Pricing model = subscription per audit-grade evidence stream. SatRank becomes the 'Plaid for agent transactions' for regulated industries. (B) Widen the catalog : aggressive Phase 10 outreach to L402 operators, build the operator dashboard, ship operator-side SDK 2.0 with one-click registration + capability inference assistance. SatRank becomes a horizontal agent infrastructure aiming for breadth. For your recommended strategy, sketch the quarterly milestones (Q1 / Q2 / Q3 / Q4), the metric that PROVES the strategy is winning, and the first product decision that the founder must make in the next 30 days. Then identify ONE technical innovation from L4 that the strategy MUST ship to win, and one strategy-level mistake the founder is most likely to make and how to inoculate against it.
